Rule.stabilize: Stops the bleeding and starts natural healing. A Mortally Wounded patient comes back to 1 HP, unconscious for a minute. The DV depends on how badly they're hurt (CRB p.222).
Rule.quickFix: Removes the injury's effect for the rest of the day; it comes back tomorrow unless the injury is treated. Some injuries are healed for good by a Quick Fix (CRB p.221).
Rule.treatment: Heals the critical injury for good. Takes four hours. A lost limb or eye is replaced with a cloned part at no extra cost (CRB p.223, p.226).
Rule.rest: A hospital bed while you heal: your BODY in HP for each day of rest. You need to be stabilized and above 0 HP (CRB p.222, p.225).
Rule.cryo: Stasis in a cryotank, run by the doctor: you heal twice as fast, your BODY in HP twice over each day (CRB p.353).
Rule.standard: A week of therapy. On a success you regain 2d6 Humanity, up to your maximum; installed cyberware lowers that maximum (CRB p.229).
Rule.extreme: A week of intensive therapy. On a success you regain 4d6 Humanity, up to your maximum (CRB p.229).
Rule.addiction: A week of therapy that frees you of one addiction. The GM removes it from your sheet (CRB p.229).
Rule.install: Bring the cyberware; the doctor puts it in. It takes four hours, and you roll Humanity Loss as usual. Each facility can only do installations up to its own level (CRB p.110, p.226).

Speech.Success: All done. Try not to come back too soon.
Speech.Failure: That didn't go to plan. We'll talk about it.

Rule.repair: A full repair back to perfect condition, at the item's price category DV with the skill that fixes it, plus the Tech's Field Expertise (CRB pp.140, 147). Clears Neon At Home's Damaged, Destroyed and malfunctions, and restores armor SP.
Rule.vehicle: A full repair of the vehicle: SDP back to full, plating SP restored, bulletproof glass replaced and its critical injuries fixed (CRB p.140).
Rule.upgrade: Upgrade Expertise: one upgrade per item, at the item's price category DV. Materials cost the item's price category; vehicles count as Very Expensive (CRB p.148).
Rule.fabricate: Fabrication Expertise: built from a blueprint. Materials cost one price category less than the item (CRB p.148).
Rule.invent: Invention Expertise: pitch an idea, a new item or an upgrade for existing gear. The GM decides whether it works and sets its price category or heat, which sets the DV and the Tech's fee. On a success a new item becomes a blueprint you can have fabricated, and an upgrade goes on sale here (CRB p.148).
Rule.tupInstall: An Invented Tech Upgrade, installed by this Tech. You pay Cost #1 (the materials of any upgrade: the item's price category, vehicles as Very Expensive), Cost #2 (the invention's own materials) and labor. It's the item's one upgrade (CRB p.148, Invented Tech Upgrades DLC).
Rule.tupKit: A materials kit: pay Cost #2 now and take it home. Your crew's Tech installs it with an Upgrade check at its DV, paying Cost #1, and after one success they can install it again in other items (Invented Tech Upgrades DLC).

chromeEtching.Name: Chrome Etching
chromeEtching.Effect: Laser-etched patterns with a faint glow inlay. +1 to Wardrobe & Style Checks while it's on show, and anyone who's seen it will recognize it again.

glowSights.Name: Glow Sights
glowSights.Effect: Self-lit sight inserts. The GM treats dim light as good light when you aim this weapon. No help in total darkness.

quickStraps.Name: Quick-Release Straps
quickStraps.Effect: Magnetic clasps and pull-tabs. Putting this armor on or taking it off takes one Action.

moodFinish.Name: Mood Finish
moodFinish.Effect: The chrome's surface shifts color with your pulse. +1 to Wardrobe & Style Checks when it's visible, but anyone watching can tell when you're rattled.

serialScrub.Name: Serial Scrub
serialScrub.Effect: Maker marks and serial numbers burned off, the frame re-textured. Anyone trying to trace the weapon back to you or its seller has a harder time of it (GM's call).

dashJukebox.Name: Dash Jukebox
dashJukebox.Effect: A bootleg media rig wired into the dash, a few thousand pirate tracks deep. Long rides are a lot less dull; flavor only.

whisperMode.Name: Whisper Mode
whisperMode.Effect: Status lights, beeps and fan noise can be switched off. It still shows up on scanners.

foldingFrame.Name: Folding Frame
foldingFrame.Effect: A two-handed ranged weapon folds small enough to hide under a long coat. Unfolding it takes an Action.

extendedFeed.Name: Extended Feed
extendedFeed.Effect: The weapon's standard magazine holds half again as many rounds, rounded down.

flexWeave.Name: Flex Weave
flexWeave.Effect: Reworked joints and panels. This armor's penalty to REF, DEX and MOVE is 1 lower (minimum 0).

jamGuard.Name: Jam Guard
jamGuard.Effect: A reworked feed and extractor. When this weapon would jam or break from its quality, roll 1d10: on a 6 or more it doesn't.

twinRail.Name: Twin Rail
twinRail.Effect: A machined mount gives an Exotic Weapon without attachment slots two of them.

limbLocker.Name: Limb Locker
limbLocker.Effect: A sealed compartment in a cyberarm or cyberleg holds one concealable weapon or item without using an Option Slot.

longBarrel.Name: Long Barrel Tune
longBarrel.Effect: Re-barreled and re-sighted. A pistol uses the SMG range table; an SMG uses the Assault Rifle range table.

blastPlates.Name: Blast Plates
blastPlates.Effect: Layered reactive plates. Explosives and other area attacks don't ablate this armor.

fieldFriendly.Name: Field-Friendly Build
fieldFriendly.Effect: Rebuilt with standard parts and open panels. Repairs to this item are one DV step easier (DV17 becomes DV13, and so on).

burstGovernor.Name: Burst Governor
burstGovernor.Effect: A smart feed meters each burst. Autofire and Suppressive Fire with this weapon use 5 fewer rounds (minimum 5).

overpressure.Name: Overpressure Chamber
overpressure.Effect: A reinforced chamber for hot loads. The weapon deals +1d6 damage, to a maximum of 4d6.

instinctOverlay.Name: Instinct Overlay
instinctOverlay.Effect: A threat-highlighting overlay for a cybereye. +2 to Perception Checks to spot hidden people and objects. Doesn't stack with any other Perception bonus.

compactMounts.Name: Compact Mounts
compactMounts.Effect: Packs the internals tighter. The cyberlimb gains 2 Option Slots, but its Humanity Loss goes up by 1d6.

crashCage.Name: Crash Cage
crashCage.Effect: A welded roll cage and crumple zones. Once per session, ignore one Critical Injury the vehicle would suffer.

ghostReflex.Name: Ghost Reflex Link
ghostReflex.Effect: A reflex co-processor. Once per combat, add +2 to an Initiative roll. Doesn't stack with a Solo's Combat Awareness.

pneumaticStride.Name: Pneumatic Stride
pneumaticStride.Effect: Gas-assisted leg actuators. +1 MOVE, which doesn't stack with any other MOVE increase. They hiss: -2 to Stealth while you move.

metabolicBuffer.Name: Metabolic Buffer
metabolicBuffer.Effect: Filters the worst of what you put in your body. Whenever you'd become addicted to a drug, roll 1d10: on a 6 or more, you don't.

muscleMemory.Name: Muscle Memory Core
muscleMemory.Effect: Chosen at installation: +1 to one Skill. This stacks with other Skill increases.

rotaryFeed.Name: Rotary Feed
rotaryFeed.Effect: A spun-up feed system. +1 ROF, but the magazine is halved and the weapon jams on an attack roll of 1 or 2.

neuralOverclock.Name: Neural Overclock
neuralOverclock.Effect: Speeds up the nerves the chrome is wired into. +1 REF, to a maximum of 8.

tandemTrigger.Name: Tandem Trigger
tandemTrigger.Effect: A second sear and a smart trigger group. +1 ROF; attacks made with the extra shot take -1.

aegisWeave.Name: Aegis Weave
aegisWeave.Effect: Woven nanofiber layers. +2 SP to every location that has SP, to a maximum of 18, with no added armor penalty.
